column1: # A DIFF HERE IS THE POINT. It means a pattern's noise profile changed, or a
# new pattern landed without anyone looking at its specificity. Both deserve a
# human. Never regenerate to make CI green without reading the diff first —
# `bound` rising is a pattern getting noisier.
# NOTE: `verdict` CLEAR means "this window is ABSENT from the index", i.e.
# never observed — NOT "measured to be rare". See aob-block-library-eval.md §7.
